findings.title: Fallback chain reads SiteSetting on every lookup
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList#[] calls SiteSetting.default_locale on every invocation. I18n consults the fallback list on each missing-translation lookup, and set_locale now also calls ensure_loaded!, which calls [] on every request. This adds a settings read (possibly cached but still non-trivial) on hot paths, and it can also touch the database during boot or in rake/console contexts where the initializer runs before SiteSetting is usable.

findings.title: Removing config.i18n.fallbacks from all environments relies solely on the initializer
findings.body: The config.i18n.fallbacks = true lines are removed from production, profile and the cloud66 production file, and the only replacement is the initializer that patches the backend and assigns I18n.fallbacks. If the initializer's include or assignment is not applied in some boot path (for example one that skips initializers or loads the backend earlier), fallbacks silently stop working in production with no error. The change is not reflected in any environment-specific check or test.

findings.title: ensure_loaded! runs on every request and can trigger file loading inside a global mutex
findings.body: set_locale now calls I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! on every request. The first request for each fallback locale (user locale, site default, :en) triggers load_locale, which holds LOAD_MUTEX while reading and parsing YAML files. Concurrent requests for a new locale serialize behind that lock, causing latency spikes. Preloading these locales at boot would avoid this on the request path.

findings.title: Ordering comment refers to a file that may not match the load order
findings.body: The header comment says 'order: after 02-freedom_patches.rb', but the initializer now depends on translate_accelerator.rb behaviour (I18n.ensure_loaded!) and also replaces the separate pluralization initializer that was deleted. The comment does not describe these dependencies, so a future reordering could break fallbacks or pluralization silently.

findings.title: No tests cover the new fallback behaviour
findings.body: The PR adds locale fallback ordering (user locale, site default, :en), a new ensure_loaded! API on both I18n and FallbackLocaleList, and moves the pluralization include. No spec verifies that a missing key in a user locale falls back correctly, that pluralization still works after the move, or that the fallback chain follows the site default locale.

findings.title: PR description is a placeholder
findings.body: The description reads 'Test 9' and gives no explanation of why fallbacks moved from environment configs to an initializer, what behaviour changes, or how to verify it. Reviewers cannot assess the intent or risk from the PR text.
